description.fun: Grimer is a living pile of sludge, said to be born where filthy water is exposed to radiation from the moon. It squeezes into sewer pipes to slurp up waste, and its germs are so potent that nothing will grow where it has been. Bits that break off as it travels become new Grimer. Cleaner cities have been bad news for it: with less waste to eat, it now faces extinction.
description.guide: An amorphous Poison Pokémon made of purple sludge full of bacteria, which leaves soil barren wherever it goes. It lives in polluted water and sewers, feeding on waste. It evolves into Muk, and its Alolan form is a Poison and Dark type.
description.tagline: Living sludge, now endangered by clean-up efforts

names.ja: アローラ ベトベター

description.fun: Brought to Alola to deal with its rubbish, Grimer switched from sludge to solid garbage, which turned it green and gave it 'teeth' of crystallised toxins. It doesn't smell, it's always hungry, and eating Trubbish and Garbodor has made them scarcer in Alola.

Muk is a living biohazard: plants wither just from being near it, ground it touches stays barren for three years, and its stench can make people faint. Still, it has its fans, who think the smell is a good thing. Clean-up campaigns have made it so scarce that sludge ponds are being built to keep it from dying out.
description.guide: The evolution of Grimer, a large Poison Pokémon made of toxic purple sludge that kills plants and gives off a powerful stench. It lives in polluted areas and eats waste, but cleaner cities have reduced its numbers. Its Alolan form is a Poison and Dark type.
description.tagline: A heap of toxic sludge with a devoted fan club

names.ja: アローラ ベトベトン

description.fun: A diet of rubbish gave Alolan Muk bright, multicoloured stripes, crystal fangs and claws of poison, and over a hundred kinds of toxins in its body. It's surprisingly quiet and friendly, and doesn't smell, but go too long without feeding it trash and it starts eating the furniture.
